payload.summary: Refresh the P03 epoch-zero bootstrap seed so published differential records carry presentation scope
payload.detail: The differentials corpus now labels presentation-scope text (PR on claude/bold-planck-dn3a76, commit 4628295f5), but the labelling is derived at catalogue load in withPresentationScope() rather than written into data/differentials-snapshot.json. That was deliberate: tests/site-content-publication-route.test.ts pins the P03 epoch-zero bootstrap population against a JSON block frozen inside supabase/migrations/20260824122000_add_site_content_release_and_outbox.sql, which has already reached the live database. Consequence: rows seeded from buildDefaultDifferentialRows() still carry unscoped payloads, so a published page can present group text as a diagnosis's own. Next action: on a machine with Docker and inside an approved Supabase window, write the scope into the snapshot (or re-import from the export zip with the fixed parser), refresh the frozen block plus supabase/schema.sql and supabase/drift-manifest.json following the fb0b0279b precedent, and re-run tests/site-content-publication-route.test.ts. Needs owner approval because it edits an applied migration.
